purpose: Testing the main success flow for submitting an assistantship claim.
preconditions: Student is within PG scope.
An assigned Thesis Supervisor and an assigned TA Supervisor can be resolved for the claimant.
action_or_input: Student opens assistantship claim submission.
expected_result: System accepts the claim information.

purpose: Testing the system acceptance of the claim information.
preconditions: Student is within PG scope.
An assigned Thesis Supervisor and an assigned TA Supervisor can be resolved for the claimant.
action_or_input: System accepts the claim information.
expected_result: System records the submitted claim.

purpose: Testing the system routing the claim to both the assigned Thesis Supervisor and assigned TA Supervisor for role-specific verification.
preconditions: Student is within PG scope.
An assigned Thesis Supervisor and an assigned TA Supervisor can be resolved for the claimant.
Claim is submitted.
action_or_input: System routes the claim to both the assigned Thesis Supervisor and assigned TA Supervisor for role-specific verification.
expected_result: System triggers the required submission notification.

purpose: Testing the system's ability to display the claim information and the supervisor role being exercised.
preconditions: Student is within PG scope.
An assigned Thesis Supervisor and an assigned TA Supervisor can be resolved for the claimant.
Claim is submitted and awaiting both Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor role-verifications.
action_or_input: System displays the claim information and the supervisor role being exercised.
expected_result: System displays the claim information and the supervisor role being exercised.

purpose: Testing the system's ability to review the claim.
preconditions: Student is within PG scope.
An assigned Thesis Supervisor and an assigned TA Supervisor can be resolved for the claimant.
Claim is submitted and awaiting both Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor role-verifications.
action_or_input: Supervisor reviews the claim.
expected_result: Supervisor records verification for that role.

purpose: Testing the system's ability to store the role-specific verification independently.
preconditions: Student is within PG scope.
An assigned Thesis Supervisor and an assigned TA Supervisor can be resolved for the claimant.
Claim is submitted and awaiting both Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor role-verifications.
action_or_input: Supervisor records verification for that role.
expected_result: System stores the role-specific verification independently.

purpose: Testing the system's ability to advance the claim to the Department Administrator after both required role-verifications are complete.
preconditions: Student is within PG scope.
An assigned Thesis Supervisor and an assigned TA Supervisor can be resolved for the claimant.
Claim is submitted and awaiting both Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor role-verifications.
action_or_input: Supervisor forwards the reviewed claim to the HoD.
expected_result: System records the forwarding state and triggers the relevant notification.

purpose: Testing the system's ability to display the claim and both supervisor-role verifications after the claim has been reviewed and forwarded to the HoD.
preconditions: Student is within PG scope.
An assigned Thesis Supervisor and an assigned TA Supervisor can be resolved for the claimant.
Claim is submitted and awaiting both Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor role-verifications.
action_or_input: Department Administrator opens the dually verified claim.
expected_result: System displays the claim and both supervisor-role verifications.
